title: 第1762章 真正的猛人第1761章 骑你老舅
content_zh:
雷裂崖，石殿内。
妖王天烁安坐在石椅之上，闭目不语，长眉紧锁。
金雕之主，显然在沉思。
大殿里的群妖全部沉默，没敢打扰。
直至良久之后，一名金雕大妖疑虑重重的问道：“帝君，那个人族金丹莫非真与无尘树有关？看起来不太像呢，无尘果成熟在即，我们这次不争了？”
另一名金雕大妖也开口道：“错过这次，恐怕未必有下一个百年了，这些年来树老的生机一直在消散，能不能活到百年之后都在两说。”
在座的一位女大妖沉吟道：“那个云极怎么看都是完整的人族之身，我没在他身上闻到任何妖族的气味，如果有妖族血脉，不该如此隐晦。”
之前有千玑夫人在场，金雕大妖们忌惮不已，心神都跟着不在线了。
冷静下来之后，在座的大妖纷纷怀疑起来。
只凭借一把沾染了树汁的匕首，真能证明与无尘子有关么？
天烁帝君缓缓睁眼，一双鹰目中闪烁着阴鸷的寒芒，沉声道：
“那云极的身份的确疑云重重，一次可能是巧合，那么两次肯定不会是巧合，你们别忘了他与千玑夫人的关系，云极是萤萤的爹！”
“以千眼王蛇的凶悍与恐怖，陆地上的妖族躲都来不及，万妖谷里根本没有敢睡王蛇的妖族，那云极不仅敢，还与千玑夫人有了孩子！”
“那云极，是数千年来云州之上真正的猛人！”
嘶！嘶！嘶！
妖王说完这番话，大殿里全是倒吸冷气的响动。
在座的大妖一想起千玑夫人的恐怖，全都不怀疑云极了。
连最凶的千眼王蛇都敢睡，就算云极与无尘子无关，那也绝对是个千古狠人！
狠到连妖王都敬佩万分的地步。
苍羽晃着大脑袋道：“云极那小子没什么修为，不过睡蛇的本事，老子心服口服！”

天烁帝君一听就来气，指着角落里装傻的冥鸦骂道：“看看人家云极，人家能生出条千眼王蛇，在瞧瞧你！老幺，你真给我金雕一族长脸啊！瞧你做的好事，生出来个什么鬼东西！”
苍羽很是无辜，道：“我又不会下蛋，是那泼妇生的跟我有啥关系！”
天烁帝君更怒，道：“连自家夫人都管不住，你还有理了？你个饭桶！”
苍羽不以为意，道：“感情破裂了，我有什么办法，各玩各的呗，大不了我也学人族那一套，写休书，休了那泼妇！”
那名女大妖冷笑道：“老幺，写休书之前你得做好准备，小心点，别被撕了。”
苍羽大咧咧的说道：“撕就撕呗！大不了我多写几封休书，随便撕！”
女大妖无奈摇头道：“我让你小心点自己，不是休书，你家那泼妇能撕了你。”
苍羽顿时一惊，道：“那还是算了，那泼妇太可怕，将就过吧，她能生杂种，老子在外面也没闲着，狐啊兔啊狼啊龟啊，小妾多得很！”
话说到这里，大殿里的气氛变得诡异起来。
一群大妖纷纷盯着苍羽，目光古怪。
天烁帝君的眼皮又开始狂跳，怒道：“你可真有出息！你还有龟族的小妾？你是想生几个王八蛋，养几个龟儿子是不是！”
苍羽有些尴尬，道：“大哥你怎么知道的，外面的确养着几个龟儿子呢，都不会飞，爬得还贼慢，有时候我都怀疑是不是我的种。”
天烁帝君气得直拍桌子，骂道：“那就不是你的种！你是纯血的雷翼金雕，怎么可能生出来龟儿子！”
苍羽恍然大悟，道：“对哦！我的龟儿子再不济也该有翅膀啊！他吗的！老子又被绿了！”
趁着大殿里闹哄哄，角落里冥鸦迈动小短腿往门口挪。
content_en:
Thunder Cracking Cliff, inside the stone palace.
Demon King Tianshuo sat on the stone chair, eyes closed and silent, his long eyebrows furrowed.
The Lord of the Golden Eagle was obviously deep in thought.
All the monsters in the hall were silent and did not dare to disturb.
Until a long time later, a golden eagle demon asked with doubts: "Emperor, is that human golden elixir really related to the Wuchen tree? It doesn't look like it. The Wuchen fruit is about to mature. We won't fight this time?"
Another golden eagle demon also said: "If you miss this time, I am afraid that there may not be another hundred years. The vitality of Shu Lao has been dissipating over the years. Whether he can survive for another hundred years is anyone's guess."
One of the female demons present pondered: "That Yunji looks like a complete human being. I don't smell any demon scent on him. If he has demon blood, it shouldn't be so obscure."
The presence of Madam Qianji made the golden eagle demons extremely fearful and their minds went offline.
After calming down, the big demons present became suspicious.
Can a dagger stained with tree sap really prove that it is related to Wuchenzi?
Emperor Tianshuo slowly opened his eyes, a pair of eagle eyes flashed with a sinister cold light, and said in a deep voice:
"There are many doubts about Yunji's identity. Once may be a coincidence, then twice it is definitely not a coincidence. Don't forget his relationship with Mrs. Qianji. Yunji is Yingying's father!"
"With the ferocity and terror of the Thousand-Eyed King Snake, the demon clan on the land can't even hide in time. There is no demon clan in the Ten Thousand Demon Valley who dares to sleep with the King Snake. That Yunji not only dares to sleep with the King Snake, but also has a child with Mrs. Qianji!"
"That Yunji is the real fierce man in Yunzhou for thousands of years!"
Hiss! hiss! hiss!
After the Demon King said these words, the whole hall was filled with gasps.
When the big demons present thought of Madam Qianji's terror, they all had no doubts about Yun Ji.
Even the most ferocious Thousand-Eyed King Snake dares to sleep with him. Even if Yunji has nothing to do with Wuchenzi, he is definitely a ruthless person through the ages!
He was so ruthless that even the Demon King admired him greatly.
Cang Yu shook his big head and said: "That boy Yunji doesn't have much cultivation, but he is capable of sleeping snakes. I am convinced!"
Emperor Tianshuo became angry when he heard this. He pointed at Ming Ya who was pretending to be stupid in the corner and cursed: "Look at Yunji, he can give birth to a thousand-eyed king snake. Look at you! Youngest boy, you really give me the face of the Golden Eagle clan! Look at the good things you have done and what the hell you have given birth to!"
Cang Yu was very innocent and said: "I can't lay eggs. What does it have to do with me that the shrew gave birth to them!"
Emperor Tianshuo became even more angry and said: "You can't even control your own wife, how can you still care? You're a loser!"
Cang Yu didn't take it seriously and said: "The relationship has broken down. What can I do? Everyone can play their own way. At worst, I will follow the example of the human race and write a letter of divorce to divorce that shrew!"
The female demon sneered: "Youngest, you have to be prepared before writing the divorce letter. Be careful, don't get ripped apart."
Cang Yu said carelessly: "Tear it up! At worst, I'll write a few more letters of divorce and tear it up as you like!"
The female demon shook her head helplessly and said: "I tell you to be careful with yourself. If you don't write a divorce letter, your shrew can tear you apart."
Cang Yu was suddenly startled and said: "Forget it then, that shrew is too scary, let's just live with it, she can give birth to hybrids, I am not idle outside, there are foxes, rabbits, wolves, turtles, there are many concubines!"
Having said this, the atmosphere in the hall became weird.
A group of big demons stared at Cang Yu with strange expressions.
Emperor Tianshuo's eyelids began to twitch wildly again, and he said angrily: "You are really promising! You also have a concubine from the turtle clan? Do you want to have a few bastards and raise a few turtle sons, right?"
Cang Yu was a little embarrassed and said: "Brother, how do you know? There are indeed a few tortoises outside. They can't fly and crawl very slowly. Sometimes I wonder if they are mine."
Emperor Tianshuo was so angry that he slammed the table and cursed: "Then it's not your seed! You are a pure-blooded Thunder Winged Golden Eagle, how could you give birth to a turtle?"son! "
Cang Yu suddenly realized it and said: "Yes! No matter how bad my turtle son is, he should have wings! His! I was cheated on again! "
Taking advantage of the commotion in the hall, the dark crow in the corner moved towards the door with its short legs.
